name: Plastic Menus
summary: A solid, moulded-plastic look for every Kairo menu: no glass, soft 3D edges.
description: Swaps Kairo's frosted glass (or Kairo Void's flat grey) for solid plastic: every panel, button and ring segment is a raised slab with a lit top edge, a darker side and a soft gloss. Pick the plastic's colour, how deep the slabs are and how glossy. Chosen in Visuals (Menu look), and switched back there any time.
